instruction: Please act as a professional verilog designer. Design a module that implements a 4-bit adder-subtractor with overflow detection. The module should have two 4-bit input signals and one output signal. The output signal should be the result of adding or subtracting the two input signals, depending on the value of a control signal. If the control signal is 0, the module should perform addition. If the control signal is 1, the module should perform subtraction. The output signal should also indicate if an overflow occurred during the operation.
